statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15 at least one merchant vessel is attacked, boarded, hijacked, or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf, and UKMTO records the incident.
resolution: The UKMTO incidents list (ukmto.org) shows an incident dated between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15 in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf classified as an attack, boarding, hijack, or seizure of a merchant vessel.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel is attacked, boarded, hijacked, or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15.

statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-12-15 forces of the internationally recognized Yemeni government or the Saudi-led coalition take control of the port of Hodeidah from the Houthis.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP report that Yemeni government-aligned or Saudi-led coalition forces took control of the port of Hodeidah from the Houthis on a date between 2026-09-16 and 2026-12-15.
failure_condition: The Houthis are not dislodged from the port of Hodeidah at any point between 2026-09-16 and 2026-12-15.

statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-31 the governments of Russia and Ukraine each publicly announce agreement to halt strikes on energy infrastructure of the other side.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP report that both the Russian and Ukrainian governments announced, on dates between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-31, agreement to halt strikes on energy infrastructure, bilateral or US-brokered.
failure_condition: No agreement to halt strikes on energy infrastructure is announced by both the Russian and Ukrainian governments between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-31.

statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15 a round of talks between United States and Iranian government officials, direct or mediated, is held and publicly confirmed by both governments.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP report that the United States government and the Iranian Foreign Ministry each confirmed a round of US-Iran talks, direct or mediated, held between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15.
failure_condition: No round of US-Iran talks held between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15 is confirmed by both governments.

statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-11-13 the United Nations Security Council adopts a resolution whose text names the Strait of Hormuz.
resolution: The Security Council resolutions list for 2026 (un.org/securitycouncil/content/resolutions) includes a resolution adopted between 2026-09-16 and 2026-11-13 whose preambular or operative text names the Strait of Hormuz.
failure_condition: No Security Council resolution naming the Strait of Hormuz is adopted between 2026-09-16 and 2026-11-13.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee statement issued on 2026-10-28 announces an increase in the target range for the federal funds rate.
resolution: The Federal Reserve Board press release dated 2026-10-28 carrying the FOMC statement announces a target range for the federal funds rate whose lower bound exceeds the lower bound in effect before the meeting.
failure_condition: The FOMC statement dated 2026-10-28 leaves the target range unchanged or lowers it, or no FOMC statement is issued on 2026-10-28.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED series DGS10) prints 5.00 percent or higher on at least one observation dated 2026-09-16 through 2026-10-16. Reference: 4.99 percent on the packet date.
resolution: FRED series DGS10 shows at least one observation dated 2026-09-16 through 2026-10-16 with a value of 5.00 or greater. Reference: 4.99 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 observation dated 2026-09-16 through 2026-10-16 is below 5.00 percent.

statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15 CISA adds to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog at least one entry with vendorProject Google and a product field containing Chrome or Chromium.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON feed contains an entry with vendorProject Google, a product field containing Chrome or Chromium, and a dateAdded between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject Google and a Chrome or Chromium product carries a dateAdded between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15.

statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15 Dutch authorities announce the arrest of at least one suspect in connection with the suspected sabotage that disrupted Netherlands rail traffic on 2026-09-15.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, NOS report that the Netherlands Public Prosecution Service or Dutch police announced, between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15, the arrest of a suspect for the 2026-09-15 rail sabotage.
failure_condition: No arrest of a suspect for the 2026-09-15 Netherlands rail sabotage is announced by Dutch authorities between 2026-09-16 and 2026-10-15.

statement: Between 2026-09-16 and 2026-12-15 a flood event in Kenya, Somalia, or Ethiopia carries a GDACS alert level of Orange or Red.
resolution: The GDACS event list (gdacs.org, eventtype FL) shows a flood event in Kenya, Somalia, or Ethiopia at Orange or Red alert level whose event period includes at least one day between 2026-09-16 and 2026-12-15.
failure_condition: No flood event in Kenya, Somalia, or Ethiopia carries a GDACS alert level of Orange or Red on any day between 2026-09-16 and 2026-12-15.
